summary: Corporate Gym Blocco 3 (Master Assignments) — backend-only testing. Created /app/backend/tests/test_cgym_v3_assignments.py covering POST/GET/DELETE /api/cgym/assignments plus GET /api/cgym/summary (assigned_* fields) and Blocco 1/2 regression (sessions, team-overview, roleplay start). 18/18 tests passed. All created plans and completed sessions were cleaned up at teardown (0 assignments remaining). No app code changes were needed.
critical_code_review_comments: corporate_gym.py:588 — target='users' silently drops unknown user_ids via `if u in by_id`. If ALL ids are unknown → 400; if only SOME are unknown → the plan is created for the valid subset without warning. Consider raising 400 when any submitted user_id is unknown (currently the review request wording implies 400 is expected only when the whole list resolves to empty targets, and this is how it behaves — verified in test_validation_unknown_user_id). Acceptable but worth documenting.
corporate_gym.py:655 — `overdue` is computed via string comparison on due_date (YYYY-MM-DD lexicographic) vs today.isoformat(); works while format stays YYYY-MM-DD but brittle if format ever changes.

corporate_gym.py:544 — CGYM_SLOT_TIMES defines 3 slots for per_day=3 (09:00/13:00/17:00), but the review request only mentions 09:00 and 15:00 for per_day=2. per_day=2 verified correct (09:00 + 15:00 Europe/Rome). Per-day=3 not exercised.
corporate_gym.py:582 — Tenant members query uses {parent_user_id: tid} OR {user_id: tid}; nested sub-users (grandchildren) would not appear. Not an issue for the current 2-level test setup.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test fixture creates 2 assignments (users target 6 sessions, team target 1+ session) and completes 1 session; teardown deletes plans (auto-removes non-completed sessions) and the leftover completed session. Verified 0 lingering assignments post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blocco 3 endpoints verified: POST /api/cgym/assignments (users + team targets, per_day validation, due_date validation, unknown user_id, member 403), GET /api/cgym/assignments (progress after sub PATCHes session to completata, per_user counts, overdue flag, 403 for member), GET /api/cgym/summary (assigned_total/done/pending + mandatory_pending), DELETE /api/cgym/assignments/{id} (only deletes non-completed sessions, 404 unknown, 403 member). Slot times verified 09:00/15:00 Europe/Rome for per_day=2 across 3 days. Regression on Blocco 1 (sessions, team-overview) and Blocco 2 (roleplay/start tts:false) all pass. Test file follows existing pattern (module-scoped cleanup, sessions/assignments tracking lists). Sub credentials: sub1@dalpastro.it/Sub12345!
rca_of_issue: N/A — all tests passed on the intended behavior. Initial run had a fixture bug (KeyError user_id) because /api/auth/me returns {"user": {...}} not the user object directly; fixed by unwrapping `data.get('user') or data` in owner_me/member_me fixtures.
